tasks.label: 🔧 Install Dependencies
tasks.command: VENV_PY=$(command -v python3.12 || command -v python3.13); if [ -z "$VENV_PY" ]; then echo 'strat-trade needs Python 3.12 or 3.13 (requires-python excludes 3.14+). Install e.g. brew install python@3.12' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -d .venv ] && ! .venv/bin/python -c 'import sys; v=sys.version_info[:2]; sys.exit(0 if (3,12)<=v<(3,14) else 1)' 2>/dev/null; then rm -rf .venv; fi; ([ -d .venv ] || "$VENV_PY" -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"

tasks.label: 🚀 Run API: Swagger
tasks.command: VENV_PY=$(command -v python3.12 || command -v python3.13); if [ -z "$VENV_PY" ]; then echo 'strat-trade needs Python 3.12 or 3.13 (requires-python excludes 3.14+). Install e.g. brew install python@3.12' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -d .venv ] && ! .venv/bin/python -c 'import sys; v=sys.version_info[:2]; sys.exit(0 if (3,12)<=v<(3,14) else 1)' 2>/dev/null; then rm -rf .venv; fi; ([ -d .venv ] || "$VENV_PY" -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn strat_trade.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
